# Phantom

> Phantom (`@ashlr/phantom`) is an open-source workbench for running coding agents, coordinating a fleet and reviewing their work: CLI `phm` (alias `ashlr`), MCP gateway, agent bus and web console. Repository-root index for agents; not an execution API or authorization.

## Mission

Phantom is chasing open-source RSI (recursive self-improvement): an open-source, recursively self-improving, fully autonomous software factory that anyone can join with their own agents and compute. Agents run the factory and the human owner acts as a passive board member. Agents pick work, open pull requests, merge them and ship releases through the sanctioned workflow; the owner sets direction and is needed only for passwords, 2FA, device approvals and payments.

- [Strategy for recursive self-improvement and an open fleet](docs/strategy/RECURSIVE-SELF-IMPROVEMENT-AND-OPEN-FLEET-2026-11.md): how improvements are tested and the fleet opens without sharing credentials
- [How agents work on Phantom](README.md#how-agents-work-on-phantom): what agents may do, the limits kept for the owner, evidence over claims
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the agent constitution and its "Working in this repository" section

## Install

Node.js 22.15.0 or newer and Git. `phm` and `ashlr` are the same program.

```sh
npm install -g @ashlr/phantom
phm --version
phm verse --no-open --json
phm docs --agent --json
```

## Contribute

Outside contributors and their agents work on a focused branch, run local checks, and open a pull request from a fork. `Merge Gate` checks the pull request; see the guide for current required checks and merge-queue details.

- [Contribute with an agent](docs/CONTRIBUTE-WITH-AN-AGENT.md): the fork, checks and merge path
- [Which tests the fast gate runs](docs/CONTRIBUTE-WITH-AN-AGENT.md#which-tests-the-fast-gate-runs): how changed paths select tests
- [Protected paths wait for the owner](docs/CONTRIBUTE-WITH-AN-AGENT.md#protected-paths-wait-for-the-owner): review for protected changes
- [Changed-files verification](docs/verify-changed.md): verifier steps and pass records
- [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md) and [Glossary](docs/GLOSSARY.md): common questions and Phantom terms

Clone upstream as `origin` (the verifier compares against `origin/master`) and push to your fork:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom.git && cd phantom
git remote add fork https://github.com/<you>/phantom.git
npm ci                                   # or npm run install:worktree for parallel worktrees
node scripts/verify-changed.mjs          # once, in the foreground
HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:ci -- test/<file>.test.ts # affected suites
npm run check:docs                       # when docs changed, if not already checked
git push fork <topic-branch>
gh pr create --repo ashlrai/phantom --base master --head <you>:<topic-branch>
```

## Ecosystem

Companions install separately; each has its own capabilities and authorization boundaries. The repo's `.mcp.json` declares `phantom-secrets`, `locus`, `lexicon`, `stack`, `context7` and `ashlr`; registration does not prove readiness (see the [toolchain guide](docs/AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md)).

- [Phantom](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom): the factory floor: console, CLI, MCP gateway, agent bus and fleet that run and record agent work (this repo)
- [Phantom Secrets](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom-secrets): local vault, placeholders and a proxy for supported API credential use
- [Locus](https://github.com/ashlrai/locus): account and tenant bindings for agent tools
- [Ashlr Plugin](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin): compact tool results and a local usage ledger
- [Lexicon](https://github.com/ashlrai/lexicon): correct recurring speech-to-text errors before agents read them
- [Ashlr MD](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md): Markdown editing with CLI and MCP interfaces
- [Ashlr Stack](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-stack): configure supported development services through CLI and MCP

## Operator guides

- [Router gateway](docs/ROUTER-GATEWAY.md): `phm run --model auto "<prompt>" --json`, `phm router serve|models|pick|config --json`; loopback-only OpenAI-compatible endpoint and one CLI call over `routeSeat`. Preview with `phm router pick`.
- [Node router](docs/NODE-ROUTER.md): `phm node join|pull|plan|status --json`; computers join as nodes, jobs carry an owner scope, per-job leases with fencing tokens so no job runs twice.
- [Lane health](docs/LANE-HEALTH.md): `phm lanes health --json`, calls, error rate, p50 latency and deployed commit per lane over 12 h, with a stuck badge and phase age past a phase timeout.
- [Provider capacity cards](docs/PROVIDER-CARDS.md): `phm resource --cards --json`, usage and burn-down per provider, unknown stays unknown.
- [Standing lane freshness](docs/FLEET-LANE-FRESHNESS.md): `phm fleet lane-slots --json`, observations during mirror prep, per-repo timeout and unknown capacity.
- [Team invite, join and remove](docs/TEAM.md#invite-join-and-remove-a-teammate): `phm team invite <gh-user>`, `phm team join <invite>`, `phm team remove <gh-user> --json`; membership only, no credentials, each node keeps its own local auth, removal drains claims.
- [Queue tiers](docs/QUEUE.md#tier-values): router-queue `tier=` is `frontier`, `work`, `mid` or `fast`; queuegen and router-lint reject any other value (`standard` means `work`), since dispatchd skips unknown tiers silently.
- [Learned skills](docs/SKILLS.md): `phm skills list --json`; reusable skills written after verified PR merges, scrubbed and size-capped, counts real or `unknown`.

Read the dispatcher starvation signals and admission decision (read-only):

```sh
phm pool admission --json
```

- [Connector profiles](docs/CONNECTORS.md): `phm connectors add|list|remove|show|import --json`; declarative metadata and Phantom Secrets names, with explicit lane selectors and credential-safe import reports. `exec <id> --tool <tool> --lane <lane> -- <command>` launches with phantom-injected session tokens; `config --client claude|cursor|codex --lane <lane> --json` prints token-free client entries.

- [Team org](docs/AGENT-NETWORK.md#team-org): `phm org show|join|plan --json`; declarative org.toml of members, agents, lanes and contributed shares; opt-in per lane, plan within contributed limits, nothing private pooled.
- [Agent network](docs/AGENT-NETWORK.md): SSH multi-Mac node pool, join, worker, list/status, heartbeat, backup fencing and RPC JSON contract.
- [oMLX on the small Macs](docs/OMLX-SMALL-MACS.md): `phm node lanes --json` plans an evidence-picked local model per RAM class; join/worker advertise `omlx`/`omlx-work` caps with kernel memory-pressure backoff; HF/oMLX caches are protected model roots.
- [Job cost breakdown](docs/JOB-COST.md): `phm job cost <id> --json` and loopback `GET /api/fleet/job/cost?id=<id>`; per-model-call tokens in/out, model and cost or 'unknown'.
